info.background_text:
The girl who turned her back on her past.
Though her laid-back nature makes her seem like she's just coasting along, she has the leadership necessary to keep her hot-headed teammates in line as the demolitions unit squad leader. She always speaks logically but has an oddly unsettling side. Those with good instincts tend to be wary of her. She becomes more playful when around people she likes.
